column3: MT 9:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “To the choirmaster” is rendered “To the Chief Musician,” and עַלְמוּת לַבֵּן is translated “To the tune of ‘Death of the Son.’”
The Hebrew is terse; NKJV takes “the enemy” as an address, “O enemy, destructions are finished forever!”
Close to the Hebrew; “he who seeks blood” is rendered “When He avenges blood.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reads “The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands,” and the term הִגָּיוֹן is rendered “Meditation.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִשְׁאוֹלָה (“to Sheol”) is rendered “into hell.”
